text: When canSubmit disables submission, validate explicit consent on change; do not depend on a blur the disabled submit cannot trigger. Prove consent followed immediately by submit in a real DOM test.
At the AI Accounts credential-owner boundary, decode only a named access-token projection; never cast the whole auth document or expose refresh/cookie records to a delegated consumer.
Credential-owner boundaries must reconstruct even known error instances from validated codes; never rethrow a foreign instance carrying mutable message, stack, cause or extra private fields.

For a human browser viewer, gate screenshot reads, serialized input and bounded API fetches independently; a single busy flag incorrectly turns normal overlapping I/O into session failure. Before handoff, revoke local input and pixels immediately but drain outstanding ACKs before aborting the idle viewer and sending exactly one completion; cancellation or timeout must prevent late promotion.

Revoking local browser input is not confirmation of remote cleanup. Keep one owned controller in active or retiring phase, retaining its cleanup capability until a strict same-attempt terminal acknowledgment; persist uncertain start admission across failed responses and report unconfirmed shutdown rather than resolving close with no ownership record.
